name: University of Waikato
summary: Campuses in Hamilton and Tauranga with 100+ subjects and smaller classes; the Hamilton campus covers 64 hectares of gardens and lakes.
noDeadline: Apply at any time; you pick your intake in the application

ib.text: A completed IB Diploma with a minimum of 24 points. Applicants also show English proficiency; the entry page lists the IB Diploma among the accepted evidence, with waivers for some.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer science at Waikato covers a flexible major with research in areas such as machine learning, cyber security, human-computer interaction and software engineering, taught in Hamilton and Tauranga.
programmes.selectionNote: The general international entry rule applies: a completed IB Diploma with 24 points. Fees are charged per paper, so the exact amount depends on your choices.

flagshipSource.title: Waikato Computer Science: the largest range of advanced courses in New Zealand

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws
programmes.about: The four-year professional law degree, studied in Hamilton, Tauranga or online, with the option of a Diploma in Law or a BA in Law whose papers can be credited towards the LLB.
programmes.selectionNote: Waikato lists extra English requirements for the Bachelor of Laws in its undergraduate English language document; check them before applying.

flagshipSource.title: Waikato Law: the LLB in Hamilton, Tauranga or online; QS 2026 subject ranking 251-300

notes: International students must pay tuition for the first year, or the full programme fee, to get the fees receipt needed for a student visa; fees are charged per paper.
Waikato says that all international students must hold a valid student visa and that an offer of place does not guarantee a visa.
The Tauranga campus has the same entry requirements as Hamilton, and its international cohort doubled between 2025 and 2026.
